summary: The phase's gate was answered by reading the proof, then discharged rather than merely recorded. aggOdPopFold_iff (AggregateOffDiagK1.lean:1226) touches its carrier hypotheses at exactly one step -- the bit-false branch of its cons case (:1253) -- and that step is VVecEA2.negFix_iff, for which VVecEA2.negFixFaithful_iff is the faithful counterpart, needing HasFaithfulDedekindINF alone. So the spine re-base has NO remaining proof content; everything left is restatement. Landed 622 lines across three new sorry-free modules: PriorInterfaceFaithful.lean and OuterGateFaithful.lean (the only two roots of the bridge's UZ/SZ subgraph) and AggregateOffDiagK1Faithful.lean (the discharged gate). Zero edits to any existing Lean declaration; the only edit outside the three new files is the strategic sorry's own docstring, which the phase charter explicitly permits. Full lake build green at 1921 jobs, all eleven new declarations axiom-clean, census delta zero. Remainder honestly chartered as Phase 14.3: 72 binder lines across 15 modules.

gate_answer.evidence: h_INF/h_SUP appear in aggOdPopFold_iff's proof at exactly one line, :1253, as `VVecEA2.negFix_iff M atomMap h_INF h_SUP (D q) z0 z1 h_lt`. The nil case (VVecEA2.trivialTrue_holds), the cons rewrite (VVecEA2.conjFull_iff) and the bit-true branch are all carrier-free. findings_for_orchestrator: PRIVATE IS THE STRUCTURAL OBSTRUCTION, AND IT IS MODULE-SPECIFIC. A faithful sibling can live in a NEW module only when everything it consumes is visible there. ExteriorBracket.lean's carrier-consuming path runs through kvE2_extGate_anyBit_iff (:837), which is `private` -- so its faithful sibling CANNOT live in a new module and must be added inside ExteriorBracket.lean itself, duplicating roughly 265 lines of body. That is why ExteriorBracket was diagnosed but NOT attempted here: it is a phase-sized deliverable of its own, and starting it would have risked leaving the tree red. Measured across the remainder, `private` declarations exist in 7 of the 15 remaining modules (ExteriorBracket 10, ExteriorPinnedConversePastK 6, ExteriorPinnedConverseK 5, AggregateHookDischarge 5, ExteriorNegationPastK 2, AggregateOffDiagK1 2, ExteriorGateAssembleK 1) and are ABSENT from the other 8. Note the measurement is of private-declaration COUNT per module, not proof that each private declaration sits on the carrier-consuming path -- only ExteriorBracket's has been traced. The other six need the same per-module trace before an in-file addition is committed to.

KampPrior.lean -- the single biggest chunk at 26 UZ binder lines, more than a third of the whole remainder -- has ZERO private declarations. Its faithful sibling is therefore a new module with no edit to any existing file. It is the highest-value single target left and should be scheduled early, not last as plan v8's original note suggested.

bracketEndChar_kvE2_sound_two_prior_frag (OuterGate.lean:297) is ALREADY CARRIER-FREE despite its _prior name: it binds no SemanticPriorUZ at all, because hfrag plus the four provider obligations carry the whole implication. It needed no faithful sibling and is reused verbatim at P.toExistProviders. Expect more such false positives -- a `_prior` name in this tree does not reliably mean a carrier binder, so the next dispatch should size by reading bodies, not names.

The SUP half remains unconsumed at every faithful site landed so far (the zeta wire, and now the population fold). Deleting HasFaithfulDedekindSUP from these statements would strengthen all of them. That decision is STILL not taken, deliberately, and is STILL an orchestrator-level call -- it is now supported by two independent measurements rather than one.

D13 and D16 re-flagged and UNTOUCHED as chartered. Section5Correspondence.lean's re-base table is now stale in a FOURTH way: PriorInterfaceFaithful.lean, OuterGateFaithful.lean and AggregateOffDiagK1Faithful.lean are new faithful-carrier modules its table does not list. Not this phase's territory; not edited.
